lemmas.name: B1_t2_low_flux
lemmas.statement: ∫ (u_≤j · ∇) u_j · u_j = 0 for periodic div-free u
lemmas.why: div-free + parts: (1/2) ∫ u_low · ∇(|u_j|²) = 0. T2 Lemma 1 only.

lemmas.name: B1b_t2_lemma2_dropped
lemmas.statement: T2 Lemma 2 (H^{2.3} absorbing ball) is an input to the a priori estimate
lemmas.why: Already-regular H^{2.3} is circular for large-data Track B. Not used.

lemmas.name: B2_regime_cover
lemmas.statement: 3-CONC (σ≥1/2) and SPREAD (σ≤1/2) cover (0,1]; ρ≤σ
lemmas.why: A cover of mass fractions, not a dynamics theorem. One threshold, no gap.

lemmas.name: B3_three_shell_ring
lemmas.statement: 3-shell support ⇒ ||∇ω||_∞ ≤ C 2^{2j*} ||ω||_2 and ||∇ξ||_∞ ≤ C 2^{j*} on E_c
lemmas.why: Bernstein on a triad packet. Not stretching depletion. Not all-data geometry.

lemmas.name: B3b_ring_is_not_depletion
lemmas.statement: 3-shell Ring forces cos α_3 → 0 for all data
lemmas.why: Ring bounds |∇ξ| on E_c. It does not force alignment. Biot–Savart slogan stays forbidden.

lemmas.name: B4_tube_hardy
lemmas.why: Localized Hardy with a wall term. Does not yet beat I_tube by viscosity.

lemmas.name: B4b_hardy_not_I_tube
lemmas.statement: tube Hardy ⇒ |I_tube| absorbed in ν||∇ω||_2² for all data
lemmas.why: Slow fat swirl: h = r sin(εz). Ratio |I_tube|/diss ∼ 1/ε blows as ε → 0. All-data domination is dead. Packet class still lives as B4c.

lemmas.name: B4c_packet_hardy_tube
lemmas.statement: 3-shell / packet class at δ ∼ 2^{-j*}: |I_tube| is budgeted by tube vorticity dissipation
lemmas.why: Same weight, both sides, at the packet scale. Ratio stays bounded and does not grow with j*.

lemmas.name: B4d_wall_matches_off_axis
lemmas.statement: Hardy wall 2h(δ)² is a finite off-axis charge, not the whole tube integral
lemmas.why: Spend the wall on r ∼ δ. That is the match I_off asked for.

lemmas.name: B5_swirl_visc_identity
lemmas.statement: axisymmetric (Δu)_θ = Δu_θ − u_θ/r²; angular piece ∫(u_θ/r)² sits in the tube
lemmas.why: Identity only. Ratio |I_source|/angular-mass is reported, not claimed < 1.

lemmas.name: B5b_tube_vs_viscosity
lemmas.statement: angular 1/r² viscosity dominates I_tube at δ ∼ 2^{-j*} on the packet class
lemmas.why: R_ang sits above 1 and climbs with j*. The extra 1/r² piece, alone, does not beat the source. Full D_tube still does (B4c).

lemmas.name: B5c_angular_climbs
lemmas.statement: on resolved packets, R_ang = |I_tube|/∫(u_θ/r)² climbs with j* while R_D falls
lemmas.why: Tesla’s knob on this write: turn j* up. Angular loses. Full dissipation wins. The two ratios disagree.

lemmas.name: B5d_killer_not_angular_kill
lemmas.statement: the slow fat swirl that killed B4b also kills angular domination
lemmas.why: Turn ε down: R_ang falls. The B4b killer is not the B5b killer. Source slowed; (u_θ/r)² did not care.

lemmas.name: B5e_not_a_phi_cancel
lemmas.statement: angular 1/r² failing means cancel to Φ = Γ/r²
lemmas.why: B4c already budgets the packet with full ∇ω. Keep Γ. Keep 1/r^4. The extra angular term was not the absorption.

lemmas.name: B5f_angular_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the angular 1/r² piece closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: R_ang > 1 and climbs (B5b). A failed Poincaré is not continuation. The packet tube budget is not an a priori either (B24).

lemmas.name: B5g_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading angular viscosity vs I_tube is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. No ε. No Φ. The ratio is a knob on the estimate.

lemmas.name: B6_energy_not_enough
lemmas.statement: Leray ∫ X dt < ∞ implies X ∈ L^∞ (closes the cubic enstrophy ODE)
lemmas.why: X=(T*-t)^{-1/2} has ∫X≈1.987 on a truncated interval and is unbounded. Viscosity or geometry has to do the extra work.

lemmas.name: B_phi_not_estimate_variable
lemmas.statement: pass to Φ = Γ/r² as the primary unknown
lemmas.why: The identity 1/r^4 ∂_z(Γ²)=∂_z(Φ²) is true. It moves the work onto ||Φ||_∞. Keep Γ.

lemmas.name: B7_bony_split
lemmas.statement: Π_j = T + T* + R_near + self for a Bony cut at j−N
lemmas.why: Bookkeeping identity on T^3. T2 Lemma 1 is the self piece.

lemmas.name: B7a_self_is_t2
lemmas.statement: ∫ (u_≤j · ∇) u_j · u_j = 0 (T2 Lemma 1). That is not the surviving low T.
lemmas.why: Self-flux of the peak dies. Low T is u_low feeding neighbors into Π_j.

lemmas.name: B7b_low_T_energy_class
lemmas.statement: ||u_{≤j−N}||_∞ ≲ 2^{(j−N)/2} X^{1/2} in energy class
lemmas.why: Bernstein + Cauchy–Schwarz on the low sum. No ρ improvement claimed.

lemmas.name: B7c_low_T_not_rho_uniform
lemmas.statement: spread ⇒ ||u_{≤j−N}||_∞ ≲ ρ^{1/2} X^{1/2} uniformly as ρ → 0
lemmas.why: Each low shell is ≤ ρ X. The sum in L^∞ is not. CCFS does not give G its ρ^{1/2}.

lemmas.name: B8_occupation_clock
lemmas.statement: τ_CONC + τ_SPREAD = T at threshold σ = 1/2. Switching allowed.
lemmas.why: One threshold, no gap. A clock, not a bound on X.

lemmas.name: B8a_high_jstar_short
lemmas.statement: packet budget Ẋ = X³ − ν 2^{2j*} X: hot occupation falls as j* rises
lemmas.why: B4c’s scale. High packets cannot sit hot for long on that ODE.

lemmas.name: B8b_leray_not_occupation
lemmas.statement: Leray ∫X dt < ∞ ⇒ occupation of 3-CONC is short
lemmas.why: Sit in CONC with X = (T*−t)^{-1/2}. The integral is finite. The clock runs the whole interval.

lemmas.name: B8c_occupation_not_X_bound
lemmas.statement: occupation-time bookkeeping closes a bound for X
lemmas.why: B8b sits in CONC the whole interval with unbounded X. Short NS paths occupy CONC fully; the bound, when it sits, is viscosity. The clock did not write X∈L∞.

lemmas.name: B9_glue_bookkeeping
lemmas.statement: ΔX = increment_CONC + increment_SPREAD against the B8 clock
lemmas.why: Tesla’s first knob: the two columns add. That is the apparatus, not a bound.

lemmas.name: B9a_glue_high_jstar
lemmas.statement: B4c-scale CONC (high j*) plus the clock keeps the model X bounded
lemmas.why: Same weight, both sides, at the thin packet. Olga’s instinct, Tesla’s knob.

lemmas.name: B9b_glue_low_jstar_blows
lemmas.statement: the glued ODE bounds X for low-j* CONC as well
lemmas.why: Fat slow CONC. The leftover cubic still wins. The glue is not all-data.

lemmas.name: B9c_glue_switching
lemmas.statement: switching high-j* CONC with SPREAD keeps the model X bounded
lemmas.why: The clock can flip. High packets plus energy-class T do not blow this ODE.

lemmas.name: B9d_glue_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the glued model is a closed a priori bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Typed j*=2 CONC grows; the NS packet falls. Sign of Ẋ disagrees. A sketch that points the wrong way is not an a priori.

lemmas.name: B10_energy_ceiling
lemmas.statement: packet support |k|≤K ⇒ X ≤ K² E (frozen j* has an energy ceiling)
lemmas.why: Leray’s energy, Bernstein’s support. Not a retune of the PDE. Tesla: the model forgot a knob.

lemmas.name: B10a_frozen_blow_not_ns
lemmas.statement: the B9b X→∞ trajectory at frozen j* is an NS-legal path
lemmas.why: Frozen support caps X by K² E. A near-saturated packet has no room to run to 40. The model forgot E.

lemmas.name: B10b_ceiling_not_climbing
lemmas.statement: the energy ceiling bounds X even if j* climbs
lemmas.why: K grows with j*. The cap rises. Frozen-j* hygiene is not a climbing-packet bound.

lemmas.name: B10c_climbing_not_close
lemmas.statement: CONC with climbing j* is a closed estimate for X
lemmas.why: Broken out as B11. NS did not force a saving c (B11d). The sketch is not an a priori (B11e). DNS is not an a priori (B13f).

lemmas.name: B10d_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: the energy ceiling is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes (Q1, ε, Φ-cancel)
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. No Q1. No ε. Keep 1/r^4. The knob is on the estimate, not the equation.

lemmas.name: B11_climb_bookkeeping
lemmas.statement: along a prescribed climb, ΔX equals the sum of CONC increments at the current j*
lemmas.why: Tesla’s knob on this write: c = dj*/dt. The increments still add.

lemmas.name: B11a_bounded_j_bounds_X
lemmas.statement: packet class + bounded j* ⇒ X bounded (unbounded X needs unbounded j*)
lemmas.why: Necessary condition only. Finite peak scale, finite ceiling. Not a climb law.

lemmas.name: B11b_slow_climb_blows
lemmas.statement: any positive climb rate saves the model X
lemmas.why: c=1: j* barely moves, X crosses 40. Climbing is not a charm. Tesla: turn c down.

lemmas.name: B11c_fast_climb_sits
lemmas.statement: a fast prescribed climb reaches the viscous room and the model X sits
lemmas.why: c=8: j* reaches the thin packet, viscosity owns the cubic. Same ODE as B9a, entered from below.

lemmas.name: B11d_ns_climb_law
lemmas.statement: classical NS forces a climb rate c that saves X while CONC
lemmas.why: c is prescribed here. t=0 packets do not produce c=8 (B12b). Short visc run does not (B13a). Blob and B18 paths do not (B20). The field did not hand us a saving c.

lemmas.name: B11e_climb_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the climbing model is a closed a priori bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Prescribed c=8 sits on the ODE (B11c). NS did not pick that c (B11d). On the readable window the climb has not reached the viscous room (B21). A sketch that grows while the field falls is not an a priori.

lemmas.name: B12_barycenter
lemmas.statement: on a 3-shell packet, j_bar is within 1.5 of j* and σ ≥ 1/2
lemmas.why: A readable peak scale. Tesla’s first knob on the field: you can say where the mass sits.

lemmas.name: B12a_c_from_rhs
lemmas.statement: instantaneous c = d j_bar / dt is computable from the vorticity RHS
lemmas.why: The apparatus reads the field. It does not type c=8.

lemmas.name: B12b_t0_not_saving
lemmas.statement: random CONC packets at t=0 produce c ≥ 8 (the B11c saving rate)
lemmas.why: None of the packets reach the saving climb. The field did not hand us c=8.

lemmas.name: B12c_visc_pulls_down
lemmas.statement: viscosity on a CONC packet forces an upward climb
lemmas.why: High shells damp faster. j_bar falls. Viscosity is not a ladder.

lemmas.name: B12d_evolved_not_saving
lemmas.statement: a short NS evolution of a CONC packet produces a saving climb
lemmas.why: Broken out as B13. Short missed (B13a). Longer past room time missed (B22). DNS is not an a priori (B13f).

lemmas.name: B12e_law_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the instantaneous field drift is a closed climb law for classical X
lemmas.why: A t=0 reading is not a law. The path did not write one either (B13, B20, B22). Do not sit it as dj*/dt on NS.

lemmas.name: B13_short_run
lemmas.statement: a short classical IF-RK2 step of a CONC packet stays finite; viscous X does not grow
lemmas.why: We did not stop at t=0. The field ran. Tesla: that is the next knob.

lemmas.name: B13a_no_saving_climb
lemmas.statement: a short evolution produces mean c ≥ 8 on a CONC packet
lemmas.why: Viscous c_mean is negative. Euler is ~0. Letting it run did not hand us B11c.

lemmas.name: B13b_no_high_fill
lemmas.statement: a short run fills resolved shells above the original triad
lemmas.why: Resolved mass above j*+1 stays ~0. n=32 dealias cannot host a fat j=4. Still a reading.

lemmas.name: B13c_stays_conc
lemmas.statement: the short viscous run stays 3-CONC
lemmas.why: The clock did not sneak into SPREAD. They stayed concentrated and still did not climb.

lemmas.name: B13d_visc_still_down
lemmas.statement: a short viscous evolution is a ladder for j_bar
lemmas.why: Along the trajectory, j_bar falls. Same direction as the t=0 RHS.

lemmas.name: B13e_longer_not_saving
lemmas.statement: a finer / longer run produces a saving climb
lemmas.why: Longer n=32 past the B11c room time does not produce c=8 (B22). Finer (n>32) is a box knob (B22e), not a close. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B13f_evolve_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a packet DNS run is a closed a priori bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Short missed (B13a). Longer past room time missed (B22). A decaying n=32 packet is a check, not continuation (B23).

lemmas.name: B14_strain_identity
lemmas.statement: ω·Sω = |ω|² ∑ λ_i cos² α_i on E_c
lemmas.why: Algebra in the strain eigenframe. Geometry starts here. Not depletion.

lemmas.name: B14a_conc_not_depleted
lemmas.statement: 3-CONC packets have median |cos α_3| ≤ 0.25 on E_c
lemmas.why: Median |cos α_3| sits near 1/2: random on the sphere, not depleted. CONC is a spectrum, not an alignment.

lemmas.name: B14b_ring_not_alignment
lemmas.statement: Ring Lipschitz of ξ on E_c forces cos α_3 → 0
lemmas.why: B3 bounds |∇ξ|. Direction slowly varying is not direction aligned. Biot–Savart slogan stays forbidden.

lemmas.name: B14c_cf_conditional
lemmas.statement: on E_c, samples with |cos α_3|<0.25 stretch less than |cos α_3|>0.8, relative to |λ|_max
lemmas.why: Constantin–Fefferman as a conditional. IF less aligned with extension, stretching is smaller. Not all-data.

lemmas.name: B14d_geometry_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: packet geometry closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Lipschitz direction plus a conditional on alignment is not continuation. Median |cos α_3| ~ 1/2. An if is not a bound (B25).

lemmas.name: B14e_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading strain alignment is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Geometry is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss.

lemmas.name: B15_stretch_budget
lemmas.statement: (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c is a readable stretching budget, with stretch-weighted |cos α_3|
lemmas.why: B14 subsampled efficiency. This write integrates the cubic's payers.

lemmas.name: B15a_cf_weights_budget
lemmas.statement: stretch-weighted |cos α_3| on E_c exceeds the unweighted mean by more than 0.15
lemmas.why: Constantin–Fefferman as a budget. The cubic pays more where vorticity meets extension. Not depletion of the field.

lemmas.name: B15b_majority_from_aligned
lemmas.statement: a majority of (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c comes from |cos α_3| > 0.8
lemmas.why: The aligned cap is a directional minority and a production majority. Median |cos α_3| is still ~1/2.

lemmas.name: B15c_run_not_depleted
lemmas.statement: a short viscous run depletes median |cos α_3| on E_c to ≤ 0.25
lemmas.why: Median stays near 1/2. Viscosity ate X. It did not rotate the sphere.

lemmas.name: B15d_run_keeps_aligned_budget
lemmas.statement: a short run drops the aligned share of (ω·Sω)_+ below 1/2
lemmas.why: frac_hi stays ~0.65. The cubic's payers did not leave. Tesla: time was a knob. It did not empty the cap.

lemmas.name: B15e_budget_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: an aligned stretching budget closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B26. A weighted |cos α_3| is not an a priori. Time did not empty the cap. A share is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B15f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: weighting stretching by (ω·Sω)_+ is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The budget is a knob on the estimate: a share you can miss.

lemmas.name: B16_enstrophy_identity
lemmas.statement: Ẋ = 2∫ ω·Sω − 2ν‖∇ω‖₂² on a classical CONC packet
lemmas.why: Fluids identity. Geometry weighted a leftover. This is the net.

lemmas.name: B16a_visc_owns_net
lemmas.statement: on B13-scale random 3-CONC packets, |∫ω·Sω| ≪ ν‖∇ω‖₂² and Ẋ < 0
lemmas.why: Leray’s dissipation owns the net on this ensemble. Same packets as the stretching budget.

lemmas.name: B16b_plus_not_net_cubic
lemmas.statement: the aligned (ω·Sω)_+ budget is a large net cubic on these packets
lemmas.why: Plus and minus stretch cancel at ~10^{-3}. The 65% share is 65% of a leftover that nets near zero.

lemmas.name: B16c_l2_is_not_bkm
lemmas.statement: an L² packet bound is the Beale–Kato–Majda criterion
lemmas.why: ‖ω‖_∞/‖ω‖₂ sits near 0.2 on a fat packet. BKM asks for ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not improve them into L².

lemmas.name: B16d_not_all_conc
lemmas.statement: random-phase cancellation is an a priori for every 3-CONC field
lemmas.why: This ensemble is random phase. A coherent vortex can have P ≈ (ω·Sω)_+. Fluids did not promote a packet to a class.

lemmas.name: B16e_balance_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the enstrophy balance on these packets closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B27. Viscosity owned this ensemble. That is not continuation. A cancelled net is not a bound.

lemmas.name: B16f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading ∫ω·Sω versus viscosity is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The balance is a knob on the estimate: a cancellation you can miss.

lemmas.name: B17_coherent_field
lemmas.statement: a named two-scale blob + signed strain is a readable classical CONC field
lemmas.why: Gaussian blob at (π,π,0) in u=(sin x cos z, 0, −cos x sin z). S_zz=+1 on the blob. Not a Stokes eigenfunction.

lemmas.name: B17a_net_is_plus
lemmas.statement: this coherent CONC field has |∫ω·Sω| / ((ω·Sω)_+ + (ω·Sω)_−) ≥ 1/2
lemmas.why: Net sits on the plus pile. Random-phase packets cancelled at ~10^{-3}. This field does not.

lemmas.name: B17b_cubic_not_live
lemmas.statement: the one-sided cubic owns Ẋ at the B13 working box (ν=0.1, X=2.5)
lemmas.why: Coherence killed cancellation. It did not make P large versus D. Viscosity still owns the net.

lemmas.name: B17c_tube_still_cancels
lemmas.statement: a z-independent swirl in the same strain also has net P ≈ (ω·Sω)_+
lemmas.why: ∫ cos z dz = 0 along the tube. Coherence of swirl is not the cubic. The blob had to sit where S_zz keeps a sign.

lemmas.name: B17d_blob_is_not_bkm
lemmas.statement: an L² bound on this blob is the Beale–Kato–Majda criterion
lemmas.why: The blob is more peaked than a fat packet. The criterion still asks for ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not improve it into L².

lemmas.name: B17e_coherent_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a signed-strain blob closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B28. One-sided cubic at this box is still a leftover versus D. A leftover that no longer cancels is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B17f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading a signed-strain blob, or turning ν down until Ẋ>0, is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Localization in z is a knob on the check. Turning ν down is the same knob. No Q1. No ε.

lemmas.name: B18_field_clock
lemmas.statement: τ_CONC + τ_SPREAD = T along short IF-RK2 paths of a packet and a signed-strain blob
lemmas.why: The B8 clock, read on a field. Same threshold σ=1/2. Switching still free.

lemmas.name: B18a_paths_stay_conc
lemmas.statement: short viscous packet and blob paths occupy 3-CONC for the whole interval
lemmas.why: σ never drops through 1/2. The clock has one column on.

lemmas.name: B18b_clock_did_not_save
lemmas.statement: the clock left CONC, and that is why X sat on these paths
lemmas.why: Zero switches. Packet X falls by viscosity. The blob too. The clock did not flip them into SPREAD.

lemmas.name: B18c_conc_not_short
lemmas.statement: CONC occupation is short on these Navier–Stokes runs
lemmas.why: τ_CONC = T. High-j* short (B8a) is a packet ODE. These fields did not occupy a short visit.

lemmas.name: B18d_cubic_not_live_time
lemmas.statement: the cubic is live (|P|/D ≥ 0.05) on a nonempty set of samples at the working box
lemmas.why: Zero live samples. One-sided P on the blob is still a leftover versus D. Occupation of CONC is not occupation of a live cubic.

lemmas.name: B18e_field_occ_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: field occupation closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B29. Occupation of CONC is not continuation. The clock did not leave. Field glue is not an a priori (B19e). NS climb is not an a priori (B20e). Climb sketch is not an a priori (B21e). Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). Finer DNS is not an a priori (B23e). Regularity leftover is open.

lemmas.name: B18f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading σ along an IF-RK2 path is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Sampling the clock is a knob on the check. No Q1. No ε.

lemmas.name: B19_field_rates
lemmas.statement: model Ẋ and NS Ẋ are both readable on the working-box packet and the signed-strain blob
lemmas.why: Same box as B13 / B17 / B18. Typed j* as in the sketch. j_bar is reported, not substituted.

lemmas.name: B19a_sign_mismatch
lemmas.statement: the j*=2 CONC model has the same sign of Ẋ as the NS packet
lemmas.why: Model Ẋ = +2.25. NS Ẋ ≈ −22.5. The sketch points up. The field points down.

lemmas.name: B19b_not_the_blowup
lemmas.statement: the working-box NS packet is the B9b blowup path
lemmas.why: Eight steps: model X grows. NS X falls. B9b is a typed ODE, not this field.

lemmas.name: B19c_alpha_not_the_cubic
lemmas.statement: α_c(j*) is the field cubic 2∫ω·Sω / X³
lemmas.why: Implied α sits near 0 on the packet (cancellation) and ~0.006 on the blob. The sketch used 0.4 and 0.2.

lemmas.name: B19d_gamma_not_visc
lemmas.statement: ν 2^{2j*} X is the NS visc term 2ν‖∇ω‖₂² on the j*=2 packet
lemmas.why: 2D / (γ X) ≈ 5.6. Bernstein-scale γ under-counts dissipation on a fat packet. j_bar sits near 3.

lemmas.name: B19e_field_glue_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: matching the sketch to NS Ẋ closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B30. A wrong-sign sketch is not continuation. The leftover cubic was not the field. NS climb is not an a priori (B20e). Climb sketch is not an a priori (B21e). Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). Finer DNS is not an a priori (B23e). Regularity leftover is open.

lemmas.name: B19f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading model Ẋ against NS Ẋ, or shrinking α_c until they match, is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. α_c is a knob on the estimate. No Q1. No ε.

lemmas.name: B20_field_c
lemmas.statement: c = d j_bar / dt is readable on the signed-strain blob and on B18 packet/blob paths
lemmas.why: t=0 from the vorticity RHS. Mean from Δj_bar / T on IF-RK2. Same box as B13 / B18. Typed j* is not substituted.

lemmas.name: B20a_blob_t0_not_saving
lemmas.statement: the signed-strain blob at t=0 produces c ≥ 8
lemmas.why: Viscous t=0 c ≈ −2. Euler ≈ 0. Coherence of swirl is not a saving climb.

lemmas.name: B20b_paths_not_saving
lemmas.statement: mean c on B18 packet and blob paths (visc and Euler) reaches c ≥ 8
lemmas.why: Viscous means are negative. Euler means sit near 0. Letting the clock run did not hand us B11c.

lemmas.name: B20c_blob_visc_not_ladder
lemmas.statement: viscosity on the signed-strain blob is a ladder for j_bar
lemmas.why: Along the B18 blob path, j_bar falls. Same direction as the t=0 RHS. Viscosity is not a climb.

lemmas.name: B20d_offset_not_climb
lemmas.statement: j_bar > typed j* at t=0 is a climb
lemmas.why: Packet j_bar ≈ 2.97 versus typed 2 is a static offset. Then j_bar falls. Do not substitute j_bar for typed j* and call it B11c.

lemmas.name: B34b_mesh_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: cashing n=64 DNS after a decaying n=32 path is continuation for classical X
lemmas.why: Continuation is an estimate, not a finer mesh. B23b already refused a longer interval. A finer grid is the same slogan.

lemmas.name: B34c_finer_dns_not_ns
lemmas.statement: an unrun finer DNS box is still an NS a priori
lemmas.why: The field on this box decayed. A box you did not run is not the packet. Do not sit n=64 as the estimate.

lemmas.name: B34d_mesh_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: a finer DNS run is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A mesh is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. DNS-never-blew-up at a finer n is the same refused slogan as B23d.

lemmas.name: B34e_regularity_leftover
lemmas.statement: a leftover close writes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Finer DNS is scored. The leftover is classical regularity. No closed estimate for X. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B34f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring finer DNS as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. n is a knob on the box. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B_regularity
lemmas.statement: classical 3D NS is globally regular (keep 1/r^4, no Q1)
lemmas.why: No closed estimate for X. Lemma identities are not a continuation argument.
